title: A review on chlorophyll-based active and intelligent packaging: chemistry, stability and applications in food freshness monitoring
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00637F, Review Article
Open Access

Harshita Ranjan, Manisha Joshi, Swarup Roy
Chlorophyll (Chl) is a prominent bioactive compound with high antioxidant properties. Chl-based packaging offers sustainable food packaging solutions. Chl based films preserve the nutritional quality and freshness of the food.
